title: Circular Heel Rubbing
summary: Small circles are made over the soft tissues around the heel.
instructions: Place the hand or fingers on the soft heel tissue.
direction: Circular movements over soft heel tissue.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
